steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Precambrian spans from Earth's formation (~4.6 billion years ago) to the start of the Cambrian (~541 million years ago), about 88% of geological time

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Earth formed from accretion of planetesimals; heavy elements sank to form the core while lighter material formed the mantle and crust

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The early atmosphere was rich in CO2, water vapour, nitrogen and sulfur compounds; oxygen was absent

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Stromatolites (layered structures built by cyanobacteria) appear from ~3.5 billion years ago and produced oxygen through photosynthesis
